scope: Primary-source provenance audit only; no model equations, parameters, observations, mappings or retained scientific outputs are changed.

status_scale.PASS: Primary authority, definition and retained transport/value chain are verified to the stated scope.
status_scale.WARNING: No evidence of a material numerical error was found, but the primary-source transport or equivalence proof is not yet complete.
status_scale.BLOCKER: A provenance defect prevents the scientific input from being accepted at the stated role.

sources.authority: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

selection.Element: Gross per capita Production Index Number (2014-2016 = 100)

sources.verification: The clean post-merge reproducibility run fetched the primary FAOSTAT archive from the official FAO URL and accepted it only after exact size and SHA-256 verification. The FAO catalog states base period 2014-2016 and coverage through 2024.
sources.caveat: The FAO catalog contains stale supplemental prose mentioning 2004-2006, while its abstract, lineage/base-period field and the selected data element state 2014-2016. EWD explicitly selects the 2014-2016 element.
sources.required_action: None for central reproducibility. Preserve the frozen URL, size, hash and explicit element selection.

sources.model_role: external population benchmark and plausibility guardrail; not the central observed population calibration target
sources.verification: Checked anchors agree to within four persons on a global population above eight billion. The UN identifies WPP 2024 as the official estimates/projections source and recommends CSV bulk download for advanced use.
sources.unresolved: The repository does not retain and hash the official UN bulk file, so full-file primary-to-adapter equivalence is not yet proven.
sources.required_action: Freeze the official UN WPP 2024 bulk CSV/GZ, record its checksum and compare the complete World series used by the benchmark against the adapter before replacing or certifying the adapter.

sources.model_role: central observed proxy for World3 Human Welfare Index
sources.authority: United Nations Development Programme, Human Development Report Office
sources.dataset: HDR 2025 composite indices time series / Table 2 HDI trends
sources.verification: All World anchor values published in UNDP HDR 2025 Table 2 match the retained adapter exactly.
sources.unresolved: The official UNDP full time-series file is linked by UNDP but is not retained/hash-pinned in EWD; full annual primary-to-adapter equivalence has not yet been certified.
sources.required_action: Freeze the official UNDP time-series CSV, record checksum and compare the complete World 1990-2023 HDI series. Keep the separate conceptual warning that HDI is a proxy, not a direct observation of the World3 HWI construct.

sources.model_role: energy diagnostic/candidate evidence; not a central calibration target
sources.dataset: Statistical Review of World Energy 2026, consolidated narrow dataset

current_transport.filename: Statistical Review of World Energy Narrow format.csv

sources.verification: At the pinned mirror commit, all seven Total World base series used by EWD for 1965-2025 match the processed EWD values exactly; derived fossil/non-fossil totals and shares differ only by output-format rounding (maximum observed absolute difference below 5e-8). The mirror documentation identifies the Energy Institute 2026 consolidated narrow CSV as its input.
sources.unresolved: An independent byte-level checksum of a fresh official Energy Institute download has not been obtained, because the official download is mediated by the Energy Institute access flow.
sources.required_action: Acquire the official 2026 narrow CSV independently and compare its checksum/content with the pinned transport copy. Do not change the processed series unless a discrepancy is found.

sources.model_role: direct-emissions diagnostic/candidate target; not promoted into the central model
sources.dataset: The Global Carbon Project's fossil CO2 emissions dataset, version 2025v15
sources.verification: The EWD 1990-2024 snapshot is exactly equal to the pinned transport file for every retained year/category. The primary GCP 2025v15 record supplies the underlying MtCO2 flat dataset. The primary 2024 World values for coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring and other round exactly to the one-decimal values in the EWD snapshot.
sources.boundary: Only coal + oil + natural gas are used by the direct-combustion diagnostic target; cement, flaring and other remain explicit and excluded.
sources.unresolved: A complete row-by-row comparison of the retained 1990-2024 snapshot directly against the primary Zenodo file has not yet been captured by the repository; current all-row proof is mirror-to-EWD plus primary anchor verification.
sources.required_action: Record or automate direct primary-file comparison when the Zenodo CSV can be fetched in the audit environment. No central-model change is justified by the evidence currently found.
